doc.brief: Error codes that identify various errors that can occur while using `GtkBuilder`.
doc.md:
Error codes that identify various errors that can occur while using
`GtkBuilder`.

invalid_attribute.brief: `GtkBuilder` found an attribute that it doesn’t understand.
invalid_attribute.md:
`GtkBuilder` found an attribute that
 it doesn’t understand.

invalid_function.brief: A function could not be found.
invalid_function.md:
A function could not be found. This often happens
  when symbols are set to be kept private. Compiling code with -rdynamic or using the
  `gmodule-export-2.0` pkgconfig module can fix this problem.

invalid_property.brief: The specified property is unknown for the object class.
invalid_property.md: The specified property is unknown for the object class.

invalid_signal.brief: The specified signal is unknown for the object class.
invalid_signal.md: The specified signal is unknown for the object class.

invalid_tag.brief: `GtkBuilder` found a tag that it doesn’t understand.
invalid_tag.md:
`GtkBuilder` found a tag that
 it doesn’t understand.

invalid_type_function.brief: A type-func attribute didn’t name a function that returns a `GType`.
invalid_type_function.md:
A type-func attribute didn’t name
 a function that returns a `GType`.

missing_attribute.brief: An attribute that is required by `GtkBuilder` was missing.
missing_attribute.md:
An attribute that is required by
 `GtkBuilder` was missing.

missing_property_value.brief: A required property value was missing.
missing_property_value.md:
A required property value was
 missing.

object_type_refused.brief: A specified object type is of the same type or derived from the type of the composite class being extended with builder XML.
object_type_refused.md:
A specified object type is of the same type or
 derived from the type of the composite class being extended with builder XML.

template_mismatch.brief: The wrong type was specified in a composite class’s template XML
template_mismatch.md: The wrong type was specified in a composite class’s template XML

unhandled_tag.brief: The input contained a tag that `GtkBuilder` can’t handle.
unhandled_tag.md:
The input contained a tag that `GtkBuilder`
 can’t handle.

version_mismatch.brief: The input file requires a newer version of GTK.
version_mismatch.md:
The input file requires a newer version
 of GTK.

quark.brief: Registers an error quark for [`Builder`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Builder) errors.
quark.md: Registers an error quark for [`Builder`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Builder) errors.
